extracted.intended_audience: general readers and historians interested in the history and critique of Freemasonry (18th-century France and Britain)
extracted.subtask_description: A literary/historical account and critique of the development, rituals, degrees, and political/social influence of Freemasonry in Britain and especially France during the 18th century. It surveys developments, added degrees, ideological uses of lodges, and prominent figures associated with Masonic influence.
